description:
Post a text tweet with markdown formatting converted to Unicode rich text.

Accepts standard markdown inline formatting and converts it to Unicode
Mathematical Alphanumeric Symbols that render as styled text on X:

    **bold**          -> bold
    *italic*          -> italic
    ***bold italic*** -> bold italic
    `monospace`       -> monospace

npub.description: Required. Your Nostr public key (npub1...) for credit billing.

text.description: Tweet content with optional markdown formatting.

name: excalibur_post_tweet
